title_zh: 调整望远镜视野后看清星团

scenario.label_zh: 调整望远镜并找到星团
scenario.goal_zh: 在观星活动中选择已对准目标的望远镜，并调整视野看到整个星团

context_zh: 公共观星活动中，访客在主持人帮助下使用已架好的望远镜。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Avery
sentences.text: There's quite an array of telescopes here. Which one is looking at the group of stars you mentioned?

sentences.speaker: Lin
sentences.text: This one is aimed at a star cluster. Have a look through the eyepiece.

sentences.speaker: Avery
sentences.text: I can see some bright points, but they're crowded against the edge.

sentences.speaker: Lin
sentences.text: Let me centre the view. Try again now, without moving the tube.

sentences.speaker: Avery
sentences.text: That's much clearer. I can see the whole group against the darker sky.

sentences.speaker: Lin
sentences.text: Good. That's the cluster I was describing, not a single star enlarged by the lens.
